notes: Source files stay untouched in IMG/ and Event-banners/. scripts/prepare-media.py writes the web copies listed here, without metadata. consent: approved means Joel confirmed publication in chat (photos 10 Nov 2026, flyers and brand kit 11 Nov 2026, every flyer published 11 Nov 2026). Anything withheld has its reason. From Code to Cloud photographs: Joel approved every photo in IMG/aws_FCC-5.zip for publication on 16 Nov 2026; 21 of the 75 unique photos are published, chosen for sharpness and variety. They are written to public/media/events/<event>/ and listed on the event in content/community-history.json.
